valid.name: lexical-bindings-and-assignment
valid.source:
(defvar total 0)
(defun add (value)
  (let* ((next (+ total value)) (text (str next)))
    (setq total next)
    (print text console/log)))
(export add total)

valid.name: imports-and-special-forms
valid.source:
(import "react" :default React useState)
(defun view (ready items)
  (cond
    (ready (jsx :main (object :className "ready") items))
    (t (fragment "waiting" (get React :version)))))
(export React useState view)

valid.name: expression-surface
valid.source:
(defun exercise (target key)
  (let ((plain 1))
    (vector
      (lambda (value) (put target key value))
      (get target key false)
      (js-call target :run plain)
      (object key plain)
      (quote missing)
      (js* "globalThis"))))
(export exercise)
